name: Journal
descriptor: A dated entry you read, not a row you scan. One long text, a date, and a way back to yesterday.
verify_checks: detail: the read view is emitted
detail: the row title opens it
pros: the entry is read at a comfortable width, not squeezed into a row
one field carries the writing; everything else is a label
search still finds a word from three months ago
no formatting to fiddle with, so the writing gets done
cons: no rich text, no images: plain paragraphs only
no encryption, and the file is a plain HTML file
one entry per day is a habit, not an enforcement: duplicates are allowed
no export to a diary format; JSON and CSV only
best_for: writing a paragraph or two, most days
avoid_if: entries need images, or the writing must be encrypted at rest
